_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-sonnet-5) - Authored for 008-wargear-option-completion FR-024/FR-025 (Product Owner decision 2026-08-17), for curation/carried-forward-factions.json. A curator's EXPLICIT declaration that a named faction's detail-source page may be sourced from the previous published version if this run cannot fetch it live -- never silent, never inferred. pipeline/acquire/wahapedia_html.py::acquire_wahapedia_html only treats a faction this way when its slug appears here; any other faction whose page cannot be fetched still fails the whole sweep (FR-008 unweakened). No mechanical value of any kind lives in this file -- it names a faction and a reason, nothing about what that faction publishes.
title: curation/carried-forward-factions.json

faction_slug.description: The detail source's own faction-page slug (pipeline/acquire/wahapedia_html.py::FACTION_PAGE), not a curated faction_id -- the two vocabularies can differ, and this file is read before curation ever resolves one to the other.

declared_at.description: The date a curator confirmed this faction's page could not be fetched and chose to carry it forward rather than block the release.

reason.description: A curator's sentence about the ACQUISITION FAILURE (e.g. 'sitemap omits this faction' or 'page 404s'), never about what the faction's cards say.

note.description: Optional process note. Must not quote source text.
